summary: grafana.grafana changes in Ansible 12.2.0, including fixing the apt repository, switching YUM URLs to rpm.grafana.com, deb822 for newer Debian, and several Mimir and dashboard import fixes.
questions: What changed in the grafana.grafana collection for Ansible 12.2.0?
Which YUM repo URL does the grafana role use now?
Does the grafana collection support deb822 sources?

answer_card.title: grafana.grafana changes in 12.2.0
answer_card.answer_md:
Highlights for `grafana.grafana` in Ansible 12.2.0:

- YUM repo URLs moved from `packages.grafana.com` to `rpm.grafana.com`
- Fixed broken Grafana apt repository addition; uses deb822 on newer Debian
- Falls back to an empty dict when `grafana_ini` is undefined
- Uses `grafana_ini` credentials when importing dashboards; imports custom dashboards only if the directory exists
- Mimir fixes: config validation, default listen address/port restored, download URLs fixed
- Latest GitHub version scraping no longer skipped in check mode
